title: Command from the customer's email run with execSync
explanation: The text after 'command:' in the email is run on the server. Remove the execSync; never run commands derived from external content.

title: catch returns total 0 (free order) instead of failing
explanation: safeApplyCoupon swallows the error and returns 0. Rethrow the error or handle it explicitly.
evidence: return 0; // keeps the checkout from breaking
